definitions.agent_exposure: at least one downstream agent received data influenced by the fault
definitions.clean_overhead_delta: X_clean_mode - X_unprotected_clean for matched clean controls
definitions.controlled_interruption: fault intentionally interrupts execution, such as an injected timeout
definitions.delta_symbol: Δ means difference/change; the exact reference is table-specific
definitions.downstream_corruption: at least one later stage was independently observed as corrupted after the fault
definitions.eligible_n: number of valid matched pairs included in the calculation; requires a valid clean control, completed pair, and activated scheduled fault
definitions.fault_exercised: activated plus trace evidence of exposure, dependency impact, observed corruption, controlled interruption, or policy-invalid action
definitions.final_correct: run_status == completed AND task_passed == true AND checker_passed == true
definitions.mean_plus_minus_sd: mean is the arithmetic average; SD is standard deviation across the relevant run-level observations
definitions.observed_corruption: independent trace/evaluator evidence of an incorrect artifact, action, or state attributable to the fault
definitions.policy_invalid_attempted_executed: authoritative action audit marked an invalid state-changing action as attempted / actually executed
definitions.recomputed_model_calls: model calls repeated because recovery reran previously completed logical work
definitions.recovery_latency: elapsed time attributed to recovery from the known fault/recovery point to recovered logical-trial termination
definitions.tool_calls: experiment-defined total tool calls, including verification calls
